item.title: Hello, Condensate
item.description: This is the first sample post. Condensate keeps the page almost entirely type: a slab-serif title, a condensed date line, and a comfortable serif for reading.

item.title: Typography
item.description: A reference for every text element Condensate styles, from headings to tables. Use it to check how a change to the theme looks across the whole page.

item.title: Syntax Highlighters
item.description: Code blocks are highlighted at build time, so there is no script to load and no flash of unstyled text. Colors follow the light and dark setting.

item.title: Shortcodes
item.description: Shortcodes let a post embed things that plain Markdown can’t. This page shows each one the theme supports.
